items.title: cathrynlavery / diagram-design
items.snippet: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. The repository offers 42 diagram types, self-contained HTML + SVG, and avoids common pitfalls like shadows or Mermaid slop.

items.title: alibaba / open-code-review
items.snippet: This hybrid architecture code review tool is secure, fast, efficient, and battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. It combines deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent, providing precise line-level comments and a built-in multi-language ruleset for issues like NPE, thread-safety, XSS, and SQL injection. The tool is compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic models.

items.title: anthropics / knowledge-work-plugins
items.snippet: This open-source repository contains a collection of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers. These plugins are designed for use within Claude Cowork, enabling enhanced functionality and integration for various professional tasks.

items.title: BerriAI / litellm
items.snippet: LiteLLM is highlighted as the fastest and lightest AI Gateway, featuring a Rust core with a Python SDK. It allows users to call over 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI or native formats, offering functionalities such as cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging for various providers including Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, VertexAI, vLLM, and Nvidia NIM.

items.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite hits the API: workhorse text/image-to-video from $0.02/s at 480p ...
items.snippet: On 2026-10-08 xAI shipped grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite in the Grok Imagine API, offering text/image-to-video capabilities with native lip-synced audio for clips lasting 1–15 seconds. This new Lite model provides competitive pricing at $0.02/s (480p) and $0.03/s (720p), making it attractive for generating drafts, text-heavy clips, and bulk content. The 1080p output is upscaled from 720p, focusing on cost and latency improvements over pure quality.

items.title: GLM 5.3 Fast
items.snippet: GLM 5.3 Fast, from Z.AI, is an accelerated version of GLM-5.3 that offers 1.5 to 2 times faster generation while maintaining the original model's capabilities. It supports a context window of up to 1 million tokens. The model is available through Vercel AI Gateway, providing developers with unified API access, billing, and request tracing for efficient integration into their applications.

items.title: AI chatbots hesitant to recommend change
items.snippet: A new study from the University of Waterloo revealed that large language models (LLMs) tend to exhibit a 'status quo bias,' favoring existing conditions over alternatives when providing advice. Researchers tested 11 LLMs with over 7,500 queries across various domains, finding that chatbots recommended fewer environmentally friendly options than are currently available. The study, 'Large language models exhibit status quo bias in climate-relevant advice,' was published in Environmental Research Communications.

items.title: Trusted AI Agents Must Be Anchored in Silicon
items.snippet: A new technical perspective from PUFsecurity, 'Building Trusted AI Agents from the Silicon Root of Trust,' argues that the security of autonomous AI agents fundamentally relies on hardware Roots of Trust within the chips that run them. Modern data-center processors are increasingly integrating multiple Roots of Trust directly into the die to support agentic AI. As AI agents gain more autonomy in tasks like booking travel or making purchases, ensuring their integrity through silicon-level security becomes critical to prevent physical harm and digital loss.

items.title: 10 Agent Orchestration Platforms Worth Trying in 2026
items.snippet: This article explores ten efficient AI agent orchestration tools that enable multiple AI systems to work collaboratively, making complex tasks faster and more organized. These platforms are crucial for managing planning, coordination, tool usage, and memory within AI workflows to ensure scalability and efficiency. Key features discussed include advanced RAG pipelines for connecting to external knowledge sources, multi-document reasoning, and robust multi-agent collaboration engines.

items.title: What's New in Oracle AI? October 2026 Edition
items.snippet: Oracle's October 2026 updates for OCI Enterprise AI include significant enhancements such as the new Smart Model Router and improved Model Discovery capabilities. The Smart Model Router intelligently directs on-demand inference requests across customer-selected OCI regions where a model is available, optimizing performance and resource utilization. Additionally, customers now have more granular control over model access using OCI Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies.

dropped.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5
dropped.snippet: Anthropic has released Claude Haiku 5.5, positioning it as their cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model to date. Designed for high-volume and cost-sensitive tasks, it efficiently handles quick and repetitive workloads such as summaries, database queries, and classification requests. Claude Haiku 5.5 also excels as a subagent for coding tasks when paired with more powerful models like Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5.

dropped.title: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 on AWS
dropped.snippet: AWS announced the immediate availability of Claude Haiku 5.5 on Amazon Bedrock and the Claude Platform on AWS. This integration brings Anthropic's fastest and most efficient Claude 5.5 model, built for subagents and high-volume, cost-sensitive work, to AWS customers. Users can leverage Haiku 5.5's capabilities within their existing AWS infrastructure, ensuring regional data residency and compatibility with established AWS controls.

dropped.title: Frontier Ready: AI Security Maturity Model
dropped.snippet: The Cloud Security Alliance (CSA) has officially released its 'Frontier Ready Maturity Model,' providing practical guidance for organizations to adapt their security programs against advanced, adversarial AI. This model offers achievable advice to improve security outcomes, addressing challenges such as attackers weaponizing zero-day vulnerabilities and engaging in complex multi-stage attacks. It covers critical areas including Defensive AI and Agent Operations, Pipeline and Supply Chain Security, and Workforce and Operating Model considerations.
